name: LazPaint
longDescription: Dapat membuka file berlapis (lzp, ora, pdn, oXo, psd datar), gambar multi-frame (gif, ico, tiff), file gambar datar (bmp, jpeg, pcx, png, tga, webp, xpm, xwd), gambar mentah (dng, cr2, nef, arw...), vektor (svg), serta 3D (obj). Menyediakan alat gambar, bentuk vektor, shading phong, penyesuaian kurva, filter, merender berbagai tekstur, serta dukungan scripting Python. Menggunakan widgetset Qt5.
